optin.title: Not ready yet? Get your result by email for free
optin.text: We send you a short summary of your result right away, so you have it saved.
optin.consent: Also send me a few short emails in the coming days, with insights from my report and a personal offer. Unsubscribe any time with one click.
optin.done: Sent! Check your inbox in a minute, and your spam folder just in case.

checkoutOptin: Also email me tips and tests that suit me. Optional, unsubscribe at any time.
footer: You get this email because you asked {site} to email you your {test} result.

unsubscribePage.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribePage.text: Click the button below and we will stop sending you emails.
unsubscribePage.done: You are unsubscribed. You will not get any more emails from us.
unsubscribePage.invalid: This link is not valid anymore. Reply to one of our emails and we will remove you by hand.

result.subject: Your {test} result
result.intro: Thanks for taking the {test}. Here is the short version of your result.
result.label: Your main result
result.outro: Your full report goes a lot further: all your scores, what they say about you and practical tips you can use straight away. It costs {price}, once, with no subscription.

insight.subject: One thing your {test} says about you
insight.intro: Your full report has a section for every part of your result. This one stood out in your answers.
insight.label: {dimension}: {level}
insight.outro: There is a section like this for every score in your report, with tips that fit you.

nextTest.subject: A test that goes well with your {test}
nextTest.intro: People who take the {test} often find this one eye-opening too.
nextTest.outro: It takes about {minutes} minutes and it is free.

offer.subject: Just for you: your {test} report for {price}
offer.intro: You recently took the {test}, but you have not opened your full report yet. So here is a small offer: until {date} you get it for {price} instead of {full}.
offer.outro: Your answers are saved. One click and your report is ready, with no account and no subscription.

offerEnds.subject: Last day: your {test} report for {price}
offerEnds.intro: A quick reminder: your full {test} report for {price} is available until {date}. After that the normal price of {full} applies again.
offerEnds.outro: This is our last email about your report.

pass.subject: All {count} reports for {price}
pass.intro: Thanks for getting your {test} report. Curious what the other tests say about you? With the all-access pass you unlock every report on the site at once.
pass.outro: One payment of {price}, no subscription. At your next test, choose {allLabel}.

offerBanner: Your offer from our email: your report for {price} instead of {full}, until {date}.
